title: Languages registry (data/registries/languages.json)
description: The interface languages, in the order the language control lists them: each one's own name, locale, BCP-47 tag, direction and what its built language file says about it. The source language is the fallback for every key.

source.description: The code of the source language: every key's text, and the fallback for a key a language lacks.

languages.description: Language code (a string file's column name, the ?lang= value, the language file's name) -> the language, in the order the language control lists them.

name.description: The language in its own words, as the language control shows it (never translated).

englishName.description: The language in English: the built file's _meta.language.

bcp47.description: Its BCP-47 tag: the built file's _meta.bcp47, and the page's <html lang> while it is on (the source language keeps the page's own lang).

locale.description: The Intl locale its numbers and dates are written in (packages/core/src/format.js and the runtime's formatNumber / formatDate). A language whose locale differs from the source language's also has the source's short-month dates ("01 Apr 1969") translated by the runtime.

localeNote.description: Why the tag and locale are what they are.

dir.description: Writing direction: the page's <html dir> while it is on (ltr leaves the page's own).

placeNameFields.description: The map tiles carry this language's place names, in the properties site/assets/i18n/place-name-fields.json lists (map labels and feature details use them).

standard.description: The written standard followed: the built file's _meta.standard.

terminology.description: The terminology source: the built file's _meta.terminology.

reviewedBy.description: Who reviewed the translations, once a fluent speaker has (data/i18n/README.md); null while they are drafts. Naming a reviewer marks the built file reviewed (scripts/i18n/translation-status.mjs).
